subject.title: [Feature]: Prefer Volta shim path over version-pinned Volta node path for macOS gateway LaunchAgent

question: Should OpenClaw support a Volta shim fallback for managed gateway services when no supported system Node is available?
rationale: Current docs intentionally warn on version-manager service runtimes and prefer system Node, while the reporter requests a stable Volta shim fallback as the least-brittle version-manager path.

options.title: Support Volta shim fallback
options.body: Accept resolver-level normalization from Volta tools/image paths to the accessible Volta shim, with focused tests and live macOS LaunchAgent proof before merge.

options.title: Keep system Node policy only
options.body: Reject Volta shim fallback for managed services and update docs or issue comments to say version-manager service runtimes remain warned or unsupported beyond explicit wrappers.

options.title: Route through wrapper guidance
options.body: Require users who need Volta-managed runtime behavior to install with a stable wrapper path instead of adding Volta-specific normalization to core path selection.

recommendation.title: Support Volta shim fallback
recommendation.body: Accept resolver-level normalization from Volta tools/image paths to the accessible Volta shim, with focused tests and live macOS LaunchAgent proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the original Homebrew stable-node precedent and authored the current system-Node preference behavior, making this the best available routing owner for the policy choice.
